The Jayhawks played their home games at [[Allen Fieldhouse]] as a member of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 25–10, 14–4 in Big 12 play to win the Big 12 regular season championship. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2014 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] where they lost to Iowa State. They received an at-large bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated Eastern Kentucky in the round of 64 before losing in the round of 32 to Stanford. On February 24, 2014, the Jayhawks made history in the "modern era of basketball" by clinching their 10th consecutive Big 12 regular season championship. Only UCLA had won more consecutive "power conference" championships with 13 (1967–1979).{{cite web|title=Decade of Dominance|url=http://www2.kusports.com/news/2014/feb/25/decade-dominance-kansas-earns-share-10th-straight-/|work=kusports.com}} Head Coach [[Bill Self]] also made history by passing [[John Wooden]] and [[Adolph Rupp]] (nine consecutive regular season conference championships) for the most consecutive conference championships all-time.{{cite web|title=The Bill Self Effect|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/1972580-a-decade-of-dominance-kansas-clinches-unprecedented-10th-straight-big-12-title|work=bleacherreport.com}} ==Pre-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable" !
